lemma rhs_between_cubes (x : ℕ) :
    x ^ 3 < x ^ 3 + 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x + 8 ∧ 
    x ^ 3 + 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x + 8 < (x + 3) ^ 3 := by
  cases x with
  | zero => simp
  | succ x' =>
    simp [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul, Nat.add_assoc] at *
    constructor
    · omega
    · ring_nf at *
      omega

  have h₂ : x ^ 2 ≥ 10 * x := by nlinarith

        have h₄ : 0 < x := by linarith
        have h₅ : 2 * x ^ 2 ≥ 18 * x := by nlinarith
        omega
      omega
